Anthropic 的股票现已登陆纳斯达克交易所，公司顺利完成首次公开募股。开盘后最初几分钟，股价报 111.50 美元，较 83 美元的发行价溢价 33%。

inlines.text: Anthropic 的股票现已登陆纳斯达克交易所，公司顺利完成首次公开募股。开盘后最初几分钟，股价报 111.50 美元，较 83 美元的发行价溢价 33%。

blocks.text: 此次 IPO 定价于周三敲定，已高于公司此前设定的预期区间——原本预计每股 70 至 78 美元。总体而言，本次发行将募资逾 810 亿美元，资金将分配给员工和公司自身。

inlines.text: 此次 IPO 定价于周三敲定，已高于公司此前设定的预期区间——原本预计每股 70 至 78 美元。总体而言，本次发行将募资逾 810 亿美元，资金将分配给员工和公司自身。

blocks.text: IPO 募资，加上既有融资以及配合公司上市时机进行的新一轮私募，预计将使 Anthropic 手握 2200 亿美元现金储备。正如一位分析师对 TechCrunch 所说：“Anthropic 手上的现金将比史上任何一家公司都多。”

blocks.text: 股价仍在持续波动，但按开盘价计算，公司市值将超过 2 万亿美元，比 Meta、特斯拉或沃尔玛都更值钱。市值高于它的只有五家公司：苹果、亚马逊、Alphabet、英伟达和微软。

blocks.text: 在开盘钟声敲响前的讲话中，Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 强调了公司对安全的承诺。“今天让公司在财务上处于更有利的位置，而这只会坚定我们做正确之事的决心，”Amodei 说。“如果我们能证明，在安全上做出正确选择的同时仍能打造一家极其成功的公司，业界其他人也会受到鼓舞，效仿我们的做法。我们称之为一场向上竞争。”

blocks.text: Shares of Anthropic are now trading on the NASDAQ exchange, as the company successfully executes its initial public offering. In the early minutes of availability, shares were trading at $111.50, a 33% premium over the $83 IPO price.

blocks.text: Set on Wednesday, the IPO price was already above higher than the projected range set by the company, which anticipated a price between $70 and $78 per share. All told, the offering will raise over $81 billion, directed to a combination of employees and the company’s own coffers.

inlines.text: Set on Wednesday, the IPO price was already above higher than the projected range set by the company, which anticipated a price between $70 and $78 per share. All told, the offering will raise over $81 billion, directed to a combination of employees and the company’s own coffers.

blocks.text: The IPO funding, together with existing fundraising and new private offerings timed to coincide with the company’s public market debut, will leave Anthropic with an expected $220 billion in cash reserves. As one analyst told TechCrunch, “Anthropic’s going to have more cash on hand than any company has ever had.”

blocks.text: The share price continues to fluctuate, but the opening price would put the companies market cap over $2 trillion, making it more valuable than Meta, Tesla or Wal-Mart. Only five companies boast a higher valuation by market cap: Apple, Amazon, Alphabet, Nvidia and Microsoft.

blocks.text: In a speech before the opening bell, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei emphasized the company’s commitment to safety. “Today puts the company in a stronger financial position, and in doing so, only strengthens our resolve to do the right thing,” Amodei said. “If we can show it’s possible to make the right choices on safety and still build an incredibly successful company, others in our industry will be inspired to do the same. We call this a race to the top.”
